title: Introduction to PongLens
tagline: Film the match once, and study it all year.

delivery.instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a competitive player showing someone the thing they built. Unhurried and even, with the confidence to leave a word alone rather than push it. This is an explanation, not a pitch, so nothing is hurried and nothing is sold. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is a performance hub for competitive table tennis players.
It has two sides. Players use it to study their own matches. Coaches use it to review their students' matches, and get paid for the work.
Everything on the player side starts with a match you filmed yourself.

lines.label: Upload a match
lines.text: Upload the file from your phone, or paste a YouTube link. You get an email when it is ready.

lines.label: Upload a match
lines.text: What comes back is the same match with the time between points removed, and every point cut into its own clip.

lines.label: Playback
lines.text: Playback is built for studying. Hold one side of the screen for double speed, or the other for quarter speed, and zoom in when you want to watch a single shot.

lines.label: Playback
lines.text: You can replay the point you are on, or jump straight to any other point in the match.

lines.label: Playback
lines.text: And you can stop on a frame to write a note on that point or draw on it, without leaving the video.

lines.label: Score the match
lines.text: Scoring takes about ten minutes. Each point plays, you say who won it, and the score, the game count and the serve rotation keep themselves up to date.

lines.label: Match analysis
lines.text: Once the match is scored you can read it. How you did on serve and receive, how you held up in the close points, and where the match turned.

lines.label: Match analysis
lines.text: Score more matches, and the same picture builds over time.

lines.label: Match analysis
lines.text: Placement maps show where the ball landed. The corner your opponent kept finding, and the one that kept working for you.

lines.label: Work with your coach
lines.text: You can share a match with your coach. They watch the real points and leave notes on them, in writing, drawn on the frame, or as a voice note.

lines.label: The journal
lines.text: Lessons, match notes, and photographs of your notebook pages go into one journal you can search.

lines.label: The journal
lines.text: You can also ask your journal a question, and it answers from what you have written.

lines.label: Sharing and export
lines.text: You can also export a point or a whole match with the score on the picture, to post on social media or send to someone as a link.
The other side of PongLens is built for coaches.

lines.label: What a coach sells
lines.text: A coach decides what a review includes, what it costs, and how many days they need.

lines.label: What a coach sells
lines.text: What they sell sits on their own page, along with their background and what past students have said about them.

lines.label: Payments
lines.text: Payments run through Stripe. A coach connects it once, and it pays their bank.

lines.label: A new order
lines.text: When a student buys a review, they send one of their matches and answer the coach's questions. The coach reads the answers before accepting.

lines.label: Reviewing a match
lines.text: The match reaches the coach already cut into points, so there is no scrolling through a video looking for a rally.

lines.label: Reviewing a match
lines.text: The coach watches it point by point. Everything they notice becomes a pattern, with every point where it happened attached to it.

lines.label: Reviewing a match
lines.text: They can speak the write-up instead of typing it, and PongLens checks it is complete before it is sent.

lines.label: What the student gets
lines.text: The student gets the write-up and a clip for every point the coach picked, and Stripe sends the coach their share.
PongLens is free to start. Sign up with Google or an email address, and upload your first match.
PongLens. Film the match once, and study it all year.
